Cafe in Hai Phong
Feb 2023 • Friends
This is really a nice place that you should drop by. If you wanna go somewhere for a coffee, try this one. You won't ever regret! Not only are the food and service good but the European style and the intimate atmosphere here can also bring about good views. Moreover, it is located on Le Dai Hanh street - right in the heart of the city - and just under 1 km away to the Opera House and the square. It's convenient to discover this city. By the way, I would like to give thanks to staff Lan Anh for her enthusiasm and help while I were enjoying my time there!
